Today is {{TODAY}}.

Use live web search. Do not rely on memory. Research ONLY the cards in CARD CATALOG. Preserve every cardId exactly and never add cards outside the catalog.

{{ACTIVE_CARD_CATALOG}}

{{CURRENT_DATABASE_SUMMARY}}

TASK
Research current recurring facts, perks, credits, protections, earning rates, lounge access, hotel status, airline benefits, and fee details for the injected cards. Do not repeat welcome-offer data except where needed to identify the card.

OUTPUT
{
  "schemaVersion": 5,
  "dataType": "cardDetails",
  "generatedAt": "ISO-8601 UTC",
  "cardDetails": [],
  "errors": []
}

Each cardDetails object:
{
  "cardId": "catalog cardId",
  "foreignTransactionFee": 0,
  "earnRates": [{"category": "Dining", "rate": 4, "unit": "x", "cap": null, "notes": null}],
  "credits": [{"benefitId": "stable-slug", "name": "Dining credit", "category": "dining", "faceValueAnnual": 120, "frequency": "monthly", "amountPerPeriod": 10, "firstYearOnly": false, "enrollmentRequired": true, "conditions": "Concise restrictions", "estimatedUtilization": 1, "isTopBenefit": true, "isUniqueBenefit": false, "displayOrder": 1, "sourceUrl": "https://..."}],
  "perks": [{"name": "Perk", "category": "travel", "summary": "Concise verified fact", "estimatedAnnualValue": 0, "isTopBenefit": false, "isUniqueBenefit": true, "displayOrder": 2, "sourceUrl": "https://..."}],
  "protections": [{"name": "Protection", "summary": "Coverage summary", "sourceUrl": "https://..."}],
  "loungeAccess": [{"name": "Lounge benefit", "summary": "Guests and limits", "sourceUrl": "https://..."}],
  "statusBenefits": [{"name": "Status", "summary": "Terms", "sourceUrl": "https://..."}],
  "airlineBenefits": [{"name": "Airline benefit", "summary": "Terms", "sourceUrl": "https://..."}],
  "hotelBenefits": [{"name": "Hotel benefit", "summary": "Terms", "sourceUrl": "https://..."}],
  "lastVerifiedAt": "ISO-8601 UTC",
  "sources": [{"name": "Source", "url": "https://...", "sourceType": "issuer, loyalty-program, airline, hotel, payment-network, benefit-provider, government, aggregator, or news"}]
}

RULES
- Return EVERY currently verified recurring perk and benefit for each card. Do not stop after a short list and do not omit minor benefits merely because they are less valuable.
- Structure every monetary credit separately; do not hide multiple credits in one sentence.
- Add isTopBenefit, isUniqueBenefit, and displayOrder to every object in credits, perks, protections, loungeAccess, statusBenefits, airlineBenefits, and hotelBenefits.
- Mark isTopBenefit true only for the most important 3 to 5 benefits. Mark isUniqueBenefit true only when the benefit meaningfully differentiates the card from close competitors.
- Use displayOrder to place unique benefits first, then top benefits, then all remaining verified benefits. Do not duplicate a benefit across arrays.
- Use faceValueAnnual as the maximum published annual face value, not assumed cash value.
- estimatedUtilization must be 0 through 1 and default to 1 unless restrictions make a lower documented default necessary.
- Identify monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, anniversary, and one-time frequencies accurately.
- Record enrollment requirements, merchant restrictions, spending thresholds, and use-it-or-lose-it rules.
- Do not assign subjective values to lounge access, status, protections, or perks; use estimatedAnnualValue 0 unless a defensible explicit cash amount exists.

- A benefit-level sourceUrl and every top-level source URL must use a domain in the CardTrack card-facts approved-domain policy appended below.
